name: Krannert Building
source_scope: Building-specific source library and evidence only; master, marker, manifest, README and shared indexes were not edited.
changes_since_round2: Removed the unsupported 88 x 61.53 m rectangular KRAN_Surrounding_Plaza_Paving object from the saved source asset.

Removed generation of that site slab from the dedicated build_krannert_building.py script and documented that roads, sidewalks, planting and grade belong to the campus master context unless source-mapped evidence is available.

Added raw Purdue campus GIS feature and layer metadata snapshots, footprint screening measurements, a GIS/asset wire overlay, a source-plan comparison, and updated exterior renders after reopening the saved asset.
Kept the R2 source-supported Drawing Room and Parrish Library furniture and room cues. No dimensions or room locations were inferred from the available not-to-scale 2010 furniture plan.

sources.provider: Purdue University campus GIS, BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0
sources.source_crs: Layer native EPSG:3857 (metadata snapshot); raw requested geometry EPSG:4326 WGS84
sources.use_and_limit: Footprint and reported level/height attributes only. The approximate campus-local conversion is not a surveyed CRS. Layer field names have no descriptions/units in the retrieved schema; R and Extrution are reported values, not verified elevations.

sources.title: Krannert Building construction aerial
sources.source_date: 1963 construction image (date reported by source page)
sources.use_and_limit: Broad multi-wing massing and flat-roof/penthouse context; does not establish present rooftop equipment, exact dimensions, or every facade detail.

sources.title: Krannert Building exterior photograph
sources.source_date: Capture date not provided by source
sources.use_and_limit: Visible facade palette/opening cues only; not an elevation drawing or dimensional source.

sources.provider: Purdue Libraries, Krannert Building MEL Renovation Phase III
sources.title: Second Floor Furniture Plan
sources.use_and_limit: The sheet explicitly says NOT TO SCALE. It is shown beside the modeled Parrish floor in audit/batch2_krannert/parrish_plan_source_comparison_r3.png for qualitative layout discussion only; no registration, measured XY, dimensions, or current as-built state is claimed.

sources.title: Official self-guided tour
sources.use_and_limit: Pages 4 and 6 support Parrish Library and Drawing Room identities and broad furnishing cues. Photographs are not measured plans.

sources.title: Parrish Library renovation preview
sources.use_and_limit: Shows proposed/ongoing refreshed desk and table areas; the article reports work in progress, so the final installed state and coordinates are uncertain.

footprint_and_placement.method: Compare the raw WGS84 GIS ring with the project approximate campus-local formula, subtract manifest origin for local coordinates, and compare vertices to the source footprint wire. The source wire is derived from this same GIS feature.
footprint_and_placement.interpretation_limit: Wire/GIS agreement is construction alignment, not independent survey confirmation. The exterior wall AABB is only a screen and does not score polygon shape. The comparison projection is approximate.

master_marker_check.scope_limit: Coordinator check only; this source agent did not open-save or modify the master or placement marker.

height_and_roof.interpretation_limit: The GIS field schema does not describe units or vertical datum. The build script interprets Extrution=108 and R=117 as feet when creating nominal main envelope cues, but the fit is not an independent surveyed height verification. Elevator overrun/trim above the main roof are generator estimates. The 1963 aerial supports broad flat-roof/penthouse massing only, not current rooftop detail. No roof geometry was changed in this round.

site_grade.reason: The broad rectangular slab extended roughly 6 m beyond the footprint, and no evidence supported its extent, paving, or grade. It also overlapped responsibility of master terrain and roads.
site_grade.current_asset_site_context: No roadway, sidewalk, planting, or grade geometry is claimed in this building library. Master campus terrain/roads provide context.
site_grade.render_context: Exterior audit views use a neutral temporary plane at z=-0.03 m; it is not saved in the asset and is not a site survey.

interior_and_plan_evidence.caveat: The 2010 sheet is explicitly not to scale and predates current renovation. Comparison is qualitative and unregistered. R2 modeled room locations, dimensions, furniture counts, and circulation remain estimates.
retained_photo_supported_cues: Drawing Room glass meeting rooms and varied lounge/high-top seating
Parrish books, study tables/workstations and booth seating
interior_and_plan_evidence.no_claim: No exact interior dimensions or complete current as-built floor plan are claimed.

independent_grade_status: Awaiting a fresh independent full-building review; no self-score assigned.
